li.p: When driving on available road, press Drive Assist button to turn on Highway Driving Assist.
When entering the main roads of highways (or motorways) while Smart Cruise Control is operating, Driving Assist will not turn on if Lane Following Assist is turned off.
When Smart Cruise Control and Lane Following Assist are turned on and the vehicle enters a road where Highway Driving Assist operation is possible, the system will activate automatically.
